name: WhatsApp Voice (StepFun)
description: Place WhatsApp voice calls to the owner with StepFun StepAudio 3 Realtime, and read call transcripts.

cliCommands.name: whatsapp-voice
cliCommands.description: WhatsApp voice calls: install, pair and run the sidecar

ownerNumber.label: Owner number
ownerNumber.help: Your WhatsApp number in international format. The only number called, and the only caller answered.

stepfunApiKey.label: StepFun API key
stepfunApiKey.help: StepFun key for StepAudio 3 Realtime. Falls back to the STEPFUN_API_KEY environment variable.

agentId.label: Agent
agentId.help: Which OpenClaw agent the voice consults during a call. Empty: the default agent.

ownerNumber.description: Your WhatsApp number in international format, e.g. +15551234567. The only number called, and the only caller answered.

voice.description: StepFun voice ID, e.g. jingdiannvsheng, wenrounansheng, qingchunshaonv.

assistantName.description: Fallback name, used only when the agent gives no persona briefing.

languages.description: Comma-separated language codes the voice may speak and listen for, e.g. en-US, ta-IN. Empty: any language.

voiceInstructions.description: Your own rules for the voice: language, tone, call length.

ringTimeoutSeconds.description: How long an outgoing call rings before it counts as unanswered.

maxCallMinutes.description: Calls end automatically after this. StepFun sessions are capped at 30 minutes.

silenceHangupSeconds.description: Ends a call when nobody has spoken for this long, e.g. left on hold.

answerInbound.description: Pick up when your number calls the bot. Other callers are never answered.

sendSummary.description: Message a short WhatsApp summary after each call.

realtimeConfig.description: Any StepFun Realtime session field, merged over the defaults. Reference: https://platform.stepfun.com/docs/zh/api-reference/realtime/chat

listen.description: Loopback address of the sidecar's local API.

consultListen.description: Loopback address the plugin's agent bridge listens on.

stepfunApiKey.description: StepFun API key for StepAudio 3 Realtime. Falls back to the STEPFUN_API_KEY environment variable.

agentId.description: Which OpenClaw agent the voice consults during a call. Default: the default agent.

autoStart.description: Start the sidecar on demand when a call is requested.
